annotations.title: Copy a leader with real funds

description: Start copying a leader with real funds: mode 'live' mirrors from your copy wallet — create and fund it first with create_copy_wallet. Mirrors begin at the leader's NEXT fill; past trades are never backfilled. Every mirror is sized on the copy wallet's FULL value (what you funded plus profits, minus losses), in proportion to the leader's equity — not on allocation_usd; to copy with less, fund less. Sizing includes the $10 minimum bump, so a small copy wallet gives a risk profile that does not match the leader's. mode 'paper' returns paper_copy_retired: a leader's operations are only visible to followers with real capital. Requires the 'copy' scope.

allocation_usd.description: Recorded with the follow. Mirrors size on the copy wallet's full value, not on this number (the wallet must hold the leader's minimum)

mode.description: 'live' = real funds from your copy wallet. 'paper' is retired (returns paper_copy_retired).

name: follow_leader
